steps.content: HUSH once had complete dominance. Upon entering the battlefield, they quickly repelled the attackers, destroyed numerous Underground Puppets, and gained control of the situation.
But looking at the scene around you now, this clearly doesn't declare their final victory.
As you crouch down to examine the shattered metal remains of the HUSH units, the FAC soldier hands you a report.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Due to the severe contamination in the Mania field, only one HUSH unit preserved limited data. Here—this is its energy consumption, from emergency activation to its complete destruction.
You take the report and inspect it carefully.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It entered combat right after activation. Energy consumption at a standard level, declines around the 16-minute mark, reasonable. HUSH likely gained the advantage and took control of the situation. Then...
Around 18-minute, the unit's energy consumption suddenly spiked again despite having exited combat mode, surging far beyond the warning threshold.
